method: Bonferroni: adjusted_p=min(1,2*raw_p). Require adjusted_p<=.05, final gain>=.10, no registered guard accuracy decline, complete error-free execution and passing closure audit.
preserve_existing_bounds: Trial03 keeps its original p<=.05 stage decision. The overall goal claim has the additional two-trial correction; earlier failed and successful stage readings are never rewritten.
activation: Prepare trial04 now. Run only if trial03 closes without an audited goal-family success and resource admission passes. No third trial or extra resources.
